parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: the miniScene file which is written when a frame is rendered

parameters.name: spotLight
parameters.description: quad light written for a spot light: with the power of the spot, with the intensity of the spot on its axis, or none

parameters.name: pointLight
parameters.description: lights written for a point light: a cube of six quad lights with the power of the point light, or none

objects.name: default
objects.description: writes the scene; its parameters go to the report next to the file

parameters.name: pixelSamples
parameters.description: samples per pixel and frame, for the report

parameters.name: denoise
parameters.description: whether the image is denoised, for the report

parameters.name: maxBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of bounces of a path, for the report

parameters.name: maxDiffuseBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of diffuse bounces of a path, for the report

parameters.name: maxGlossyBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of glossy bounces of a path, for the report

parameters.name: maxTransmissionBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of transmission bounces of a path, for the report

parameters.name: clampDirect
parameters.description: limit of the direct light of a sample, zero for none, for the report

parameters.name: clampIndirect
parameters.description: limit of the indirect light of a sample, zero for none, for the report
